title: Skywork-Reward-V2: Scaling Preference Data Curation via Human-AI Synergy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the RM-Bench benchmark, which tests a reward model's ability to prioritize substantive content over superficial stylistic differences. This is measured by comparing the model's accuracy across response pairs with controlled styles and varying difficulty levels (e.g., "hard" cases where a stylistically superior distractor contains factual errors).

Evaluated by comparing different data filtering mechanisms (e.g., purely LLM-based filtering versus dual-RM consistency filtering) against real human agreement rates to measure whether the curation pipeline amplifies systematic annotation errors, spurious correlations, or the inductive biases of the LLM judges.
